title: Ultrahuman theme
description: A crisp wearable-store theme: pure white page, black ink, #f0f0f0 panels and one cobalt blue (#112baf) for every buy button, with a bright battery green kept for highlights and glows. Geist throughout, JetBrains Mono for readouts, and an ultra-condensed italic Saira for promo headlines. Its dark sibling is the original's black product band: #000 page, #1a1a1a cards.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the original's black product band is the dark colours forced inside that block with the dark class
sets --ultrahuman-condensed (Saira at 50% width) for promo headlines; ultrahuman blocks fall back to the display face under other themes
name: ultrahuman-theme
